an5.100:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
an5.100:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Kakudho nāma Koliyaputto āyasmato Mahāmoggallānassa upaṭṭhāko adhunā kālakato aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno,
an5.100:1.4: tassa evarūpo attabhāvapaṭilābho hoti, seyyathā pi nāma dve vā tīṇi vā Māgadhikāni gāmakkhettāni.
an5.100:1.5: So tena attabhāvapaṭilābhena n'eva attānaṃ no paraṃ vyābādheti.
an5.100:2.1: Atha kho Kakudho devaputto yen'āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Kakudho devaputto āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ etad avoca
an5.100:2.4: saha cittuppādā ca bhante Devadatto tassā iddhiyā parihīno' ti.
an5.100:2.6: idaṃ vatvā āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev'antaradhāyi.
an5.100:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an5.100:4.1: ‘Kakudho nāma bhante Koliyaputto maṃ upaṭṭhāko adhunā kālakato aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno,
an5.100:4.2: tassa evarūpo attabhāvapaṭilābho, seyyathā pi nāma dve vā tīṇi vā Māgadhikāni gāmakkhettāni.
an5.100:4.3: So tena attabhāvapaṭilābhena n'eva attānaṃ no paraṃ vyābādheti.
an5.100:4.4: Atha kho bhante Kakudho devaputto yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho bhante Kakudho devaputto maṃ etad avoca
an5.100:4.7: saha cittuppādā ca bhante Devadatto tassā iddhiyā parihīno" ti.
an5.100:4.9: idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev'antaradhāyī' ti.
an5.100:5.1: ‘Kiṃ pana te Moggallāna Kakudho devaputto cetasā ceto paricca vidito
an5.100:5.2: "yaṃ kiñci Kakudho devaputto bhāsati, sabban taṃ tath'eva hoti no aññathā" ti'?
an5.100:5.3: ‘Cetasā ceto paricca vidito me bhante Kakudho devaputto
an5.100:5.4: "yaṃ kiñci Kakudho devaputto bhāsati, sabban taṃ tath'eva hoti no aññathā" ti'.
an5.100:5.7: Idāni so moghapuriso attanā'va attānaṃ pātukarissati.
an5.100:6.1: Pañc'ime Moggallāna satthāro santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an5.100:6.3: Idha Moggallāna ekacco satthā aparisuddhasīlo samāno ‘parisuddhasīlo 'mhī' ti paṭijānāti ‘parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan' ti.
an5.100:6.5: ‘ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhasīlo samāno "parisuddhasīlo'mhī" ti paṭijānāti "parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan" ti,
an5.100:6.6: mayaṃ c'eva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma: nāssassa manāpaṃ.
an5.100:6.7: Yaṃ kho pan' assa amanāpaṃ, kathaṃ nu mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma?
an5.100:6.9: Yaṃ tumo karissati, tumo 'va tena paññāyissatī' ti.
an5.100:6.10: Evarūpaṃ kho Moggallāna satthāraṃ sāvakā sīlato rakkhanti,
an5.100:6.11: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi sīlato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsati. 3.
an5.100:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ Moggallāna idh'ekacco satthā aparisuddhājīvo samāno ‘parisuddhājīvo'mhī' ti paṭijānāti ‘parisuddho me ājīvo pariyodāto asaṃkiliṭṭho' ti.
an5.100:7.3: ‘ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhājīvo samāno "parisuddhājīvo 'mhī" ti paṭijānāti "parisuddho me ājīvo pariyodāto asaṃkiliṭṭho" ti,
an5.100:7.4: mayaṃ c'eva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma: nāssassa manāpaṃ.
an5.100:7.5: Yaṃ kho pan'assa amanāpaṃ, kathaṃ nu mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma?
an5.100:7.7: Yaṃ tumo karissati, tumo 'va tena paññāyissatī' ti.
an5.100:7.8: Evarūpaṃ kho Moggallāna satthāraṃ sāvakā ājīvato rakkhanti,
an5.100:7.9: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi ājīvato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsati. 4.
an5.100:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ Moggallāna idh'ekacco satthā aparisuddhadhammadesano samāno ‘parisuddhadhammadesano 'mhī' ti paṭijānāti ‘parisuddhā me dhammadesanā pariyodātā asaṃkiliṭṭhā' ti.
an5.100:8.3: ‘ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhadhammadesano samāno "parisuddhadhammadesano 'mhī" ti paṭijānāti "parisuddhā me dhammadesanā pariyodātā asaṃkiliṭṭhā" ti,

an5.100:8.7: Yaṃ tumo karissati, tumo 'va tena paññāyissatī' ti.

an5.100:9.1: Puna ca paraṃ Moggallāna idh'ekacco satthā aparisuddhaveyyākaraṇo samāno ‘parisuddhaveyyākaraṇo 'mhī' ti paṭijānāti ‘parisuddhaṃ me veyyākaraṇaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan' ti.
an5.100:9.3: ‘ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhaveyyākaraṇo samāno "parisuddhaveyyākaraṇo'mhī" ti paṭijānāti "parisuddhaṃ me veyyākaraṇaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan" ti,

an5.100:9.8: Evarūpam kho Moggallāna satthāraṃ sāvakā veyyākaraṇato rakkhanti,
an5.100:9.9: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi veyyākaraṇato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsati. 6.
an5.100:10.1: Puna ca paraṃ Moggallāna idh'ekacco satthā aparisuddhañāṇadassano samāno ‘parisuddhañāṇadassano 'mhī' ti paṭijānāti ‘parisuddhaṃ me ñāṇadassanaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan' ti.
an5.100:10.3: ‘ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhañāṇadassano samāno "parisuddhañāṇadassano 'mhī" ti paṭijānāti "parisuddhaṃ me ñāṇadassanaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan" ti,

an5.100:10.7: Yaṃ tumo karissati, tumo 'va tena paññāyissatī' ti.

an5.100:10.9: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi ñāṇadassanato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsati.
an5.100:10.10: Ime kho Moggallāna pañca satthāro santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. 7.
an5.100:11.1: ‘Ahaṃ kho pana Moggallāna parisuddhasīlo samāno "parisuddhasīlo 'mhī" ti paṭijānāmi "parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan" ti.
an5.100:11.2: Na ca maṃ sāvakā sīlato rakkhanti, na cāhaṃ sāvakehi sīlato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmi.
an5.100:11.3: Parisuddhājīvo samāno "parisuddhājīvo 'mhī" ti paṭijānāmi "parisuddho me ājīvo pariyodāto asaṃkiliṭṭho" ti.
an5.100:11.4: Na ca maṃ sāvakā ājīvato rakkhanti, na cāhaṃ sāvakehi ājīvato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmi.
an5.100:11.5: Parisuddhadhammadesano samāno "parisuddhadhammadesano 'mhī"ti paṭijānāmi "parisuddhā me dhammadesanā pariyodātā asaṅkiliṭṭhā" ti.
an5.100:11.6: Na ca maṃ sāvakā dhammadesanato rakkhanti, na cāhaṃ sāvakehi dhammadesanato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmi.
an5.100:11.7: Parisuddhaveyyākaraṇo samāno "parisuddhaveyyākaraṇo 'mhī" ti paṭijānāmi "parisuddhaṃ me veyyākaraṇaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan" ti.
an5.100:11.8: Na ca maṃ sāvakā veyyākaraṇato rakkhanti, na cāhaṃ sāvakehi veyyākaraṇato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmi.
an5.100:11.9: Parisuddhañāṇadassano samāno "parisuddhañāṇadassano 'mhī" ti paṭijānāmi "parisuddhaṃ me ñāṇadassanaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan" ti.
an5.100:11.10: Na ca maṃ sāvakā ñāṇadassanato rakkhanti, na cāhaṃ sāvakehi ñāṇadassanato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmī' ti.
an5.100:12.4: ca araññaṃ sīha-Kakudhena te dasā ti. 1.
